description: Conformance cases for the dispute_resolution extension. Each case gives a DisputeRecord (input.record) and, for the determination checks, a DisputeDetermination (input.determination). expect states what a provider following the RFC decides. See README.md in this directory for the fields.

readings_stated.approval binding (D8, D8b, D8c, D8d): Section 4.4a: recompute approval_digest from items and approved_at, and check it equals the digest the merchant received
readings_stated.intent conflict (D8): Section 7.4 rule 4: a finding against the agent platform; the charge stands
readings_stated.adjustment types for rule 3 (E1, E2, E7): Section 7.4 rule 3: a completed adjustment of a type counted in rule 1
